Lets DirectInput games make the controller vibrate: plain rumble, and the force effects racing and flight games send to a wheel or a joystick, felt through the controller\'s two motors. It follows the Vibration settings (rumble target and intensity). A steady force (a racing game holding the wheel straight, for example) fades after a couple of seconds, so the controller doesn\'t keep buzzing. DirectInput games only feel it while they can see the controller. A change applies when the controller reconnects (in-game, Controls › Pad does that) or on the next launch.
